title: Establish stable-pin hash + perf-signature pipeline for new model onboarding
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Goal: Create a reproducible, auditable pipeline that produces a stable pin (artifact hash) for each newly onboarded model, computes a compact performance signature, and publishes an associated metadata + human-readable doc to the model catalog. This work reduces on-call churn from silent regressions and simplifies rollbacks by making model variants and their perf guarantees discoverable.

Scope:
- Define stable pin artifact format (model weights hash + tokenizer fingerprint + container image digest + manifest version).
- Implement perf-signature generator that runs our standard microbench harness (latency P50/P95, throughput per GPU, token cost estimate, memory footprint, quantization variant deltas) and emits a compact signature file.
- Build a GitHub Action that triggers when a model manifest is added/updated in the onboarding repo, runs reproducible checks, attaches the pin + signature to the manifest, and opens a docs PR that updates the Catalog entry with performance summary and compatibility notes.
- Add gating rules: fail the publish if perf deltas exceed configured thresholds or if the signature generation is non-deterministic.
- Create a short publish-playbook doc and example CLI for manual pin creation for air-gapped/private customers.
acceptance_criteria: A stable-pin artifact (JSON) is produced for every new model manifest added to onboarding repo
Perf-signature contains P50/P95 latency, throughput, peak GPU memory, and cost-per-1k-tokens estimates
GitHub Action auto-opens a Catalog docs PR that includes the pin, signature summary, and a human-friendly compatibility matrix
Publish is blocked when perf delta > configured threshold (default: P95 latency +15% or peak memory +10%)
Manual pin CLI exists and is documented for private/on-prem flows
work_items: Spec stable-pin JSON schema and add examples
Implement perf harness runner as a reusable container (linux/gpu) and unit tests
Author GitHub Action: run harness, compute signature, validate thresholds, create PR
Integrate signature publishing step with Catalog backend and mark pinned release
Document playbook: how to interpret signatures, rollback steps, and common troubleshooting
Add a lightweight regression dashboard panel that surfaces newly onboarded models with perf alerts
risks: Non-determinism in perf measurements due to infra variability — mitigated by fixed load profiles, warmup runs, and seed locking
Long runtimes for signature generation could delay onboarding — mitigate via sampled inputs and parallelization across ephemeral runners
Upstream model changes after pinning (e.g., optimizer strip) — require strict manifest immutability and artifact storage
Private/on-prem customers may need an offline flow — include CLI and TAR artifact export in scope
